title: שבעת הגשרים שאי אפשר לחצות — והטיול שהמציא מתמטיקה חדשה
summary: The Seven Bridges of Königsberg: Euler (1735, aged 28) turns the city into dots and lines and counts degrees 5,3,3,3 — every pass through a vertex uses an in/out pair, so only start and end may be odd, hence impossible; one-stroke drawing lab (house, butterfly, square-with-X), handshake lemma (sum of degrees = 2 × edges), 1944 bombing leaves 5 bridges and makes an island-to-island walk possible; Waze, Chinese postman, football seams (60×3÷2 = 90); addition-and-halving, degree-sum, factorial-and-hours challenge.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (2 rounds) — nits left: est. ~30–35 min per track vs the 'כ־25 דקות' tag even after trims; kit lint/check missing from the repo so local stand-ins were used; Arto and the AI grader not exercised offline; review copy doesn't declare the sample capability (template)
